subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Windows Companion promote `2026.7.2-beta.2` as its default before an official artifact containing the upstream wizard-runtime correction can pass the native-wizard E2E flow?
rationale: The code cannot make the selected official package complete the setup path, and choosing a prerelease default despite that known failure is a release-policy decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Defer the beta default
options.body: Keep a setup-proven released default and promote the beta line only after an official artifact containing the upstream correction passes exact-head Companion E2E.

options.title: Accept the prerelease risk
options.body: Adopt `2026.7.2-beta.2` now while explicitly accepting that fresh native-wizard setup currently fails until the separate core fix is released.

recommendation.title: Defer the beta default
recommendation.body: Keep a setup-proven released default and promote the beta line only after an official artifact containing the upstream correction passes exact-head Companion E2E.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is release/default policy rather than a localized implementation detail.
